description: This file defines a Unity MonoBehaviour class 'TimedObjectActivator' used for scheduling actions (activate, deactivate, destroy, reload level) on GameObjects after specified delays. It also includes custom editor code for Unity Inspector integration to manage these scheduled entries.

classes.name: TimedObjectActivator
classes.description: Main class managing timed actions on GameObjects, such as activate, deactivate, destroy, and reload scene.

methods.name: Awake
methods.description: Initializes scheduled actions based on entries during object startup.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Coroutine to activate a target GameObject after a delay.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Coroutine to deactivate a target GameObject after a delay.

methods.name: ReloadLevel
methods.description: Coroutine to reload the current scene after a delay.
